summary: inclHFin(k) ∈ K iff inclHFin(k) − 1 is integral (the lattice form is unimodular); translate this by forall_inclHFin_sub_one_iff into a condition on k and use the integrality criteria for middleBaseChange.

steps.claim: inclHFin(k) ∈ K iff inclHFin(k) − 1 is integral: K is the level-1 unitary group of the unimodular lattice form (unitaryLevel_one, IsUnimodular.mem_unitaryLevel).
steps.lean:
(Ô E ∙ ↑S.piBar) fun () ↦ 𝔰.k₀ := .trans ⟨(·.isIntMatrix.sub .one), by simp_all [latStabilizer,
  ← unitaryLevel_one, S.isUnimodular_latMiddle.splitGram.mem_unitaryLevel, -IsIntMatrix]⟩

steps.claim: By forall_inclHFin_sub_one_iff (with P = integrality), this is integrality of middleBaseChange(π̄)·(k − 1)·diag(conj(π̄⁻¹) at k₀). ⇒: by isIntMatrix_middleBaseChange_mul (b) with right factor diag(conj(π̄) at k₀), k − 1 is integral with row k₀ in π̄Ô, so k is in the congruence group (k = (k − 1) + 1 integral). ⇐: by isIntMatrix_scaleAt_sub_one (π̄ a unit at w or w̄ by N_split) and isIntMatrix_middleBaseChange_mul (a).
steps.lean:
((S.forall_inclHFin_sub_one_iff _ (by simp)).trans ⟨fun h ↦
  (S.isIntMatrix_middleBaseChange_mul.2.1 (by
    simpa +contextual [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← star_mul, -Matrix.diagonal, -IsIntMatrix] using
      IsIntMatrix.mul h (N := scaleAt (star S.piBar.1) 𝔰.k₀) (by simp [piBar_mem, star_mem_Ô]))).imp
  (mem_Kf.2 <| by simpa using ·.add .one) (by simp),
  S.isIntMatrix_middleBaseChange_mul.1 ∘ isIntMatrix_scaleAt_sub_one _ _ (by grind [N_split])⟩)
